mechanism_narrative: A sustained 6-month increase in GDP growth (GDPC1) above its 2-year moving average signals accelerating economic activity, which historically correlates with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings expectations rise.
failure_condition: If 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) during periods of accelerating GDP growth, or if the correlation between GDP acceleration and SPX returns breaks down in a rolling 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the industrial production index (INDPRO) below its 6-month moving average signals weakening manufacturing activity, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings expectations fall.
failure_condition: If 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) during periods of declining industrial production, or if the correlation between INDPRO declines and SPX returns breaks down in a rolling 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A 1-month increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above its 3-month moving average signals tightening monetary policy, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as discount rates rise and equity valuations contract.
failure_condition: If 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) during periods of monetary tightening, or if the correlation between FEDFUNDS increases and SPX returns breaks down in a rolling 3-year window.
